rc6.1 hot-fix release: razzfazz-upgrade.sh migrate_env version-compare bug fix only. The compare_versions / sort_key parsers now correctly handle the rcN.M form (e.g. 2026.05-rc5.1, 2026.05-rc6.1). Without this fix, the rc6 migration entry's 65 env_changes were silently skipped on rc5.1 → rc6 upgrades — boxes ended up with stale image tags (DIFY_VERSION etc.) and a caddy crash loop (missing CRAWL4AI_DOMAIN). rc6.2 hot-fix release: two more migrate_env bugs surfaced during the M023-S05.2 big-bang test (2026.04-ga → 2026.05-rc6.1 on box-002). (1) The bash IFS=':' read in the apply loop split URL-shaped `default` values on their `://` colon — e.g. CREATORS_PLATFORM_API_URL=https://creators.dify.ai landed in .env as just `https`, crashing Dify's pydantic validator. Fix: switch the field separator emitted by the Python heredoc and consumed by the bash loop to U+001F (ASCII Unit Separator), which never appears in env-value content. (2) read_env_value returned a value verbatim including any trailing ` # inline comment` from .env.example — e.g. KOMODO_DB_VERSION=17-0.106.0-ferretdb-2.5.0 # ferretdb-postgres compared as `17-0.106.0-ferretdb-2.5.0 # ferretdb-postgres`, which never matched the change_default rule's old_default and was silently "preserved as custom value". Fix: strip a trailing whitespace-prefixed `#` comment from unquoted values before returning; quoted values keep their interior literal. No env changes; no images bumped; no rebuild needed. Tests: tests/test-migrate-env-edge-cases.sh — 6 cases covering both bugs + RENAME and quoted-value behaviour. IMPORTANT: customers still on 2026.04-ga must use ./razzfazz-upgrade-from-2026.04-GA.x.sh as the bootstrap; running ./razzfazz-upgrade.sh directly from a 2026.04-ga checkout keeps the OLD (buggy) script in bash memory and these fixes never take effect.

rc6.3 hot-fix release: bootstrap-workflow bug surfaced during the rc6.2 big-bang re-test on box-002 (2026.04-ga → 2026.05-rc6.2 via ./razzfazz-upgrade-from-2026.04-GA.x.sh). The bootstrap fetches itself onto a 2026.04-ga checkout via `git show <target>:razzfazz-upgrade-from-2026.04-GA.x.sh > razzfazz-upgrade-from-2026.04-GA.x.sh`, which leaves it as an UNTRACKED file. The target tag (rc3+) has the bootstrap tracked, so razzfazz-upgrade.sh's `git checkout <target-tag>` aborted with 'untracked working tree files would be overwritten by checkout'. Fix #1 (bootstrap): bootstrap removes itself from the working tree (`rm -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"`) just before exec'ing razzfazz-upgrade.sh — bash has the source in memory so this is harmless for the running process, and the upcoming `git checkout` materialises the file back from the target tag. Fix #2 (defense-in-depth, in razzfazz-upgrade.sh code_update_git): use `git stash push -u` (--include-untracked) so any other operator-added untracked file that collides with the target tag also gets stashed instead of blocking the checkout. .gitignore'd files (.env, .env.dify, etc.) are not affected by stash -u. No env changes; no images bumped; no rebuild needed. IMPORTANT: 2026.04-ga customers still need to use the bootstrap, but now with the rc6.3-or-newer version of it: `git show v2026.05-rc6.3:razzfazz-upgrade-from-2026.04-GA.x.sh > razzfazz-upgrade-from-2026.04-GA.x.sh`.

rc6.4 hot-fix release: post-install /etc/hosts gap surfaced during the M023-S05.2 big-bang test on box-002. (1) razzfazz-post-install.sh's setup_local_dns used a HARDCODED subdomain list ('chat dify llm auth ... pdf') that drifted every release: crawl4ai (added rc6) was missing, and any future *_DOMAIN module would also be missing until somebody manually edited the list. Fix: derive the FQDN list from .env's `*_DOMAIN` keys at runtime (data-driven), expand `${MAIN_DOMAIN}` literals, exclude external domains like GOOGLE_OAUTH_DOMAIN=seqis.com by checking the FQDN actually ends with ${MAIN_DOMAIN}. New modules pick up automatically. (2) Added `razzfazz-post-install.sh --refresh` — idempotent post-upgrade re-config that runs ONLY setup_local_dns + ensure_gpustack_api_key. This is what razzfazz-upgrade.sh's new post-upgrade reminder block points operators at. (3) Destructive-state guard: --preset on a previously-initialised stack now refuses to run unless --force is passed, after surfacing what specifically would be overwritten (existing GPUStack models, Open WebUI / Dify / Gitea operator state, plugin selections). Auto-detected via .razzfazz_initialized marker and live GPUStack model count. (4) razzfazz-upgrade.sh prints a post-upgrade reminder block guiding operators to ./razzfazz-post-install.sh --refresh; we deliberately do NOT auto-call post-install from upgrade because --preset is destructive and would silently undo operator customisations the upgrade itself just preserved. No env changes; no images bumped; no rebuild needed.

rc6.5 hot-fix release: gpustack CPU image tag fix surfaced during the M023-S05.3 big-bang test on box-004 / 8.93 (CPU testvm-cpu preset). llm/compose.devices.cpu.yml previously appended `-cpu` to GPUSTACK_VERSION, producing `gpustack/gpustack:v2.1.2-cpu` — a tag that does NOT exist on Docker Hub. `docker compose pull` returned `manifest for gpustack/gpustack:v2.1.2-cpu not found: manifest unknown` and the upgrade aborted before restart. Root cause: the v0.7.1-era pattern of per-hardware image variants (`-cpu`, `-rocm`) was discontinued upstream when gpustack v2.x consolidated everything into a single unified image; the F-RC5-6 attempted slim-CPU mitigation in rc5.1 was based on an upstream variant that never shipped for v2.x. Fix: drop the image override in compose.devices.cpu.yml — the CPU overlay now inherits the unified `gpustack/gpustack:${GPUSTACK_VERSION:-v2.1.2}` from llm/compose.yml, same as AMD/NVIDIA. F-RC5-6 (CVE-debt from the bundled CUDA/ROCm wheels on a CPU box) stays as a known issue for 2026.05-ga; a slim variant requires a custom multi-stage build, out of scope for this release. requires_pull:true (post-upgrade docker compose pull picks up the corrected tag without a rebuild).
